description: Canonical Battle Factory rental-draft anchor, byte-identical at frame 0 to the battle-scene-on profile. This profile sets Options > Battle Scene OFF in canonical RAM after the shared input bootstrap and before the shared 60 settle frames. Move/effect and species front-sprite entrance animations are skipped by the real game; battle rules, input, party generation, and the main battle RNG remain the reference implementation.

pokes.note: SaveBlock2+0x15 options high byte: 0x03 -> 0x07 sets u16 bit 10 (optionsBattleSceneOff). Applied after the inherited scripted bootstrap with zero frames and zero RNG impact.
